description: Role-to-model mapping for dev-pipeline multi-role orchestration. Used by run-next.sh and documentation; the orchestrator reads this to know which model handles each role.

PM.description: Product Manager — writes PM briefs, defines scope and acceptance criteria

Architect.description: Architect — designs components, file changes, constraints, risks

Dev.description: Developer — implements code, writes patches and dev notes
constraints: Cannot change scope or acceptance criteria

QA.description: QA — tests implementation, writes test report

Review.description: Reviewer — checks policy compliance, stage gating, diffs
